content: Depit Kemwurimwuriong Solomon
Ni ahnsou me Depit kereniongehr sipalla, e ahpw malipehdo sapwellime pwutak Solomon oh kemwurimwuriong, mahsanih,
“Ahnsoun ei pahn mehla kerendohr. Ke pahn ahneki koapworopwor,

oh kapwaiada soahng kan me KAUN-O omw Koht kupwurki ke en wia. Kapwaiada sapwellime kosonned akan oh mahsen koaros me ntingdier nan Kosonned en Moses, pwe ke en kak pweida ni soahng koaros me ke pahn wia wasa koaros me ke pahn kohla ie.

Ma ke pahn wia met, KAUN-O pahn ketin kolokol oh kapwaiada inowo me e ketin wiahiong ie, dene kadaudokei kan pahn kakaun Israel erein arail pahn kanakanahieng oh peikiong oh kapwaiada sapwellime mahsen kan, oh loalopwoat nan mohngiongirail unsek.

“Pil ehu, ke tamataman dahme Sohap wiahiong ie ni eh kemehla kaunen sounpein Israel riemeno, Apner nein Ner oh Amasa nein Seder? E kemeirahla ni ahnsoun mwehi mwahu, pwe en dupukohng ira kamaramas me ira wiadahr nan mahwen. E kemelahr aramas soh-dipe kei, oh met ngehi me pwukoahki dahme e wiadahro. Oh I pil lokolongki dahme e wiadahro.
Ke wehwehki dahme ke pahn wiahiong, ke sohte pahn mweidohng en pein mehla, ahpw en kamakamala.
“Ahpw ke pahn kadekohng nein Parsilai pwutak ko mehn Kilead, oh apwalih irail, pwehki arail kadekohng ie ni ahnsou me I rukusang riomw pwutak Apsalom.

“Ahpw duwen Simei nein Kera, mehn kisin kahnimw Pahurim nan wehin Pensamin, e lokaia suwed oh kate ie ni rahn me I kolahng Mahanaim, ahpw ni ahnsou me e tuhwong ie ni Pillap Sordan, I inoukihong ni mehlel me I sohte pahn kemehla.
Ahpw ke sohte pahn mweidohng en sohte ale kalokolok. Ke wehwehki dahme ke pahn wiahiong; ke pahn mwasamwasahnte pwe en uhdahn kamakamala.”
Sipallahn Depit
Depit eri sipalla oh seridi nan Serusalem.
E ketin wiahier nanmwarkien Israel erein sounpar 40, e ketiket nan Epron erein sounpar 33.
Eri, Solomon ahpw wiliandi seme Depit oh wiahla nanmwarki; oh sapwellime wehi pil kehlailla mehlel.
Sipallahn Adonaisa
Eri, Adonaisa me eh nohno Akkid, ahpw patohla rehn Padsipa, en Solomon eh nohno. Liho ahpw idek reh, “Mwemweit mwahu ehu met?” E ahpw sapeng, patohwan, “Ei.”
E ahpw pil usehla patohwan, “Mie mehkot me I men peki rehmwi.” Liho ahpw idek, “Dahkot mwo?”

E ahpw sapeng, patohwan, “Komw mwahngih me I uhdahn pahn wiahla nanmwarki oh aramas koaros nan Israel wie kasikasik. Ahpw met wekidekla, oh riei pwutak me wiahla nanmwarki pwehki iei met kupwur en KAUN-O.
Oh met mie ehu pekipek me I men wia; menlau komw dehpa soikala.” Padsipa eri idek, “Dahkot mwo?”
E ahpw sapeng, “Menlau peki rehn Nanmwarki Solomon—I ese me e sohte pahn soikala omwi pekipek—en mweidohng ie Apisak, serepein en Sunemo, pwe I en pwoudiki.”
Liho eri sapeng, “Me mwahu, I pahn lokaiaiong nanmwarkio ni edomw.”

Padsipa eri patohla rehn nanmwarki oh koasoiong ni eden Adonaisa. Nanmwarkio eri ketida pwehn rahnmwahwih eh nohno oh poaridiong. E ahpw ketidiong nan mwoale oh mahsanih pil ehu mwoahl en wisikido, liho eri mwohndiong loale ni palimaune.
Liho ahpw patohwan, “Mie mehkot tikitik me I men peki rehmwi; komw kupwurkalahngan oh dehr ketin soikala.” E ahpw keinemwe, “Dahkot mwo ino, I sohte pahn soikala omwi pekipek.”
Liho ahpw ndahng, “Mweidohng riomwi Adonaisa en pwoudiki Apisak.”

Nanmwarki ahpw keinemwe, “Dahme komw pekihki I en kihong en pwoudiki Apisak? Komw seu pil pekihte I en pil kihong mwoalen nanmwarki? Mehlel, ih riei pwutak laud, samworo Apaiadar oh Sohap kin uhpalihki!”
Solomon eri wiahda inou lap ehu ni mwaren KAUN-O, e mahsanih, “KAUN-O en ketin kemeiehla ma Adonaisa sohte pwainkihla eh mour pekipek met!

KAUN-O ketin kamanaiongieier mwoalen semei Depit; e ketin dadaurete sapwellime inou oh ketikihdo wehio rehi oh rehn kadaudokei kan. I kahukihla ni mwaren KAUN-O me ketin ieias me Adonaisa pahn mehla rahnwet!”
Nanmwarki Solomon ahpw ketin koasoanediong Penaia, me kohla oh kemehla Adonaisa.
Sohralahn Apaiadar oh Mehlahn Sohap

Nanmwarki Solomon ahpw mahsanihong samworo Apaiadar, “Kohwei nan uhdahn sapwomw nan Anadod. E konehngehr ke en mehla, ahpw I sohte pahn mweidohng ke en kamakamala met, pwehki omw apwahpwalih sapwellimen KAUN-O Kohpwahn Inou nindokon omw patopato rehn ei pahpa Depit, oh ke iang ih nan sapwellime apwal akan koaros.”
Solomon eri kihsang Apaiadar nan eh pwukoahn papah nin duwen samworo en KAUN-O men, eri ahpw pweida dahme KAUN-O mahsanih nan Sailo duwen samworo Ilai oh kadaudoke kan.
Sohap rongehr dahme pweidahr. (E kin uhpalihki Adonaisa, a e sohte uhpalihki Apsalom.) Eri, e ahpw sopolahng ni Impwal me KAUN-O kin ketiket loale oh koledi keimw kan en pei sarawio.

Ni ahnsou me rohng lel Nanmwarki Solomon me Sohap sopolahngehr nan Impwalo oh mihmi ni pei sarawio, Solomon ahpw kadaralahng Sohap meninkeder men pwehn idek re dahme e tangkihla ni pei sarawio. Sohap ahpw sapengki me e tangalahng rehn KAUN-O pwehki eh masak Solomon. Nanmwarki Solomon eri kadarala Penaia pwehn kemehla Sohap.

E ahpw kohla ni Impwal me KAUN-O kin ketiket loale oh ndahng Sohap, “Nanmwarki mahsanih ke en pedohido.” Sohap eri sapeng, nda, “I pahn mehla wasaht.” Penaia eri pwurala rehn Nanmwarki oh padahkihong dahme Sohap patohwan.
Solomon ahpw mahsanih, “Kapwaiada dahme Sohap nda, kemehla oh sarepedi. Eri, sohte emen kadaudok en Depit de ngehi pahn pwukoahki dahme Sohap wia ni eh kemelahr ohl soh-dipe kan.

KAUN-O pahn ketin kaloke Sohap pwehki kamaramas me e wiadahr ni semei Depit eh sohte mwahngih. Sohap kemehla ohl soh-dipe riemen me mwahusang ih: Apner, kaun lapalap en karis kan en Israel, oh Amasa, kaun lapalap en karis kan en Suda.
Kalokepen kamaramas pwukat pahn kohdiong pohn Sohap oh kadaudoke kan kohkohlahte. Ahpw KAUN-O pahn ketikihong kadaudok en Depit me kin pato nan mwoalen nanmwarki en kin pweida ahnsou koaros.
Penaia eri kohla ni Impwal me KAUN-O kin ketiket loale oh kemehla Sohap, e ahpw seridi nan eh wasa nan sahpw patapato.
Nanmwarkio eri wiahkihla Penaia kaun lapalap en karis kan wiliandi Sohap oh Sadok uhd wiliandi samworo Apaiadar.
Mehlahn Simei
Nanmwarki eri poaronlahng Simei, mahsanih, “Kauwada imwomw nan Serusalem. Koukousoan loale oh ke dehr mweselsang nan kahnimwo.
Ma ke pahn kohla oh daulihala Piletik Kidron, ke uhdahn pahn mehla—oh pein kowe me pahn pwukoahki.”
Simei ahpw sapeng, patohwan, “Maing, Wasa Lapalap, I pahn kapwaiada me komwi mahsanih.” Ih eri koukousoan nan Serusalem ahnsou reirei.
Ahpw mwurin sounpar siluh, riemen nein Simei lidu ko ahpw tang kolahng rehn Akis nein Maaka, nanmwarkien Kad. Ni Simei eh rongada me ira mihmi nan Kad,
e ahpw kaunopada were ahs oh kohla rehn Nanmwarki Akis nan Kad, pwehn rapahki nah lidu ko. E ahpw diarirahda oh kapwureirahla ni imweo.
Ni Solomon eh karongehda dahme Simei wiadahr,

e ahpw ketin poaronlahng, mahsanih, “I wiahiong uhk inou ehu ni mwaren KAUN-O me ke en dehr mweselsang Serusalem. Oh I kehkehlingkihong uhk ma ke pahn wia met, ke uhdahn pahn mehla. Ke seu pwungki ire wet oh nda me ke pahn kapwaiada?
Eri, dahme ke kauwehkihla omw inou oh sapeingkihong ei koasoandi?
Ke inenen wehwehki duwen sapwung kan koaros me ke wiahiong semei Depit. KAUN-O pahn ketin kalokehkin uhk irair wet.
Ahpw e pahn ketin kupwuramwahwih ie, oh e pahn ketin kupwurehda pwe wehin Depit en tengeteng kohkohlahte.”
Nanmwarkio eri koasoanediong Penaia en kohla kemehla Simei. Eri met Solomon ahnekilahr manaman unsek.
